text.content:
STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Numerical audit

These observations follow directly from arithmetic or missing fields in the supplied blocks. Fixed HP can be used as intentional values; the parenthetical formulas then need not be rolled. A custom attack bonus may be deliberate and is not automatically 'wrong' because it differs from a standard proficiency calculation.

Source field Issue Proposed practical treatment
Babha HP 330 (40d10 + 120) Dice average is 340 Use fixed 330; do not roll the contradictory formula.
Mama HP 330 (40d10 + 120), CON +5 Same average issue; bonus also does not match 40 dice at CON +5 Use fixed 330; preserve her Constitution as supplied.
Cauldron HP 200 (16d10 + 96) Average is 184; Huge size normally uses larger hit dice Use fixed 200.
Hut HP 300 (24d10 + 144) Average is 276 Use fixed 300.
Valdershmort HP 325 (23d12 + 161) Average is 310.5; Constitution modifier differs from the formula's implied bonus Use fixed 325.
Valdershmort WIS Score missing; only -4 modifier supplied Leave unresolved in actor conversion; choose and announce a score if building an Actor.
Gahgah WIS 16 (+4) Score 16 normally gives +3 The listed saves may be intentionally custom. Suggested base ability modifier +3, without silently changing listed save/skill bonuses.
Gahgah HP 325 (22d10 + 198) Average is 319 Use fixed 325.
Gahgah Claw 17 (2d10 + 8) Formula averages 19 Choose the supplied fixed 17 or the written dice; disclose which.
Valdershmort Bite 22 (3d8 + 8) Formula averages 21.5, normally rounded down to 21 Keep fixed 22 if that is the intended custom value.
Hut/Gahgah passive Perception Does not transparently match base Wisdom/listed Perception Preserve fixed passive values unless the GM adopts a recalculation.

No actors are imported by this journal pack, so none of these decisions is silently baked into a character sheet.

STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Required rulings before a full-coven fight

Babha - Soul Steal: no damage is given. Suggested completion: DC 22 Charisma save; failure takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and maximum HP is reduced by damage actually taken until a long rest; success takes no effect. Do not add soul imprisonment or temporary HP without explicitly choosing those further changes. This is a proposal, not source text.

Baleful polymorph: the exact spell text was not supplied. Attach the intended homebrew spell, or explicitly substitute Polymorph before play. Do not silently use effects from another game system.

Cackle: the source lacks repeat saves. Suggested: repeat at each affected creature's turn end. No added paralysis.

Summon Servants: unlimited summoning and 'other creatures of her choice' are unbounded. Choose allowed stat blocks and a maximum active group before combat. Never introduce a stronger unknown creature merely to negate the party's plan.

Cauldron hover: suggested: use the fly speed's hover normally and ignore the redundant Dash restriction, but label the change. No new splash attacks.

Hut Teleport: the original wording can take unwilling creatures within 120 feet without a stated save. Decide eligibility and save before an encounter; suggested only willing creatures or a clearly announced Charisma save for unwilling targets. Its range remains the supplied 10 miles.

Mama - summoned Yuan-ti: supply a number and named stat blocks. 'A unit' is not a runnable quantity. Venomous Bite: suggested use her normal +12 attack bonus and 5-foot reach. Yuan-ti Magic: either add a specific eligible known spell openly, or leave this option unavailable; the examples are not actually granted by her spell list. Recharge Innate Magic: suggested restore one expended per-day use of a chosen spell of 5th level or lower, not unlimited Power Word Kill cycles. Snake form: preserve the unusual no-bite rule unless the user chooses to change it.

Valdershmort legendary gaze: suggested select one creature able to see its eyes and resolve an initial gaze save; do not force an accelerated second petrification save before the stated end of its next turn. This prevents ambiguous double-triggering.

Gahgah normal Multiattack: not defined; suggested two claw/bite attacks as a normal action if a full actor is needed. Legendary Multiattack: costs only one point if read literally, giving up to six extra attacks per round. Suggested cost two points, clearly labelled as a balance change. Regeneration legendary action: suggested refresh the existing effect, not stack another 20 per round with itself. Acid remains the suppressor. Headbutts: suggested +15 to hit, 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning before the stated save. Spellcasting: suggested Charisma, DC 19, but the source did not say this.

Riders and mounts: the source grants access to mount abilities without defining action economy. Suggested use independent creatures with their own turns; a rider does not gain a duplicate set of attacks simply by sitting on the mount. Mounted AC bonuses apply exactly as supplied. Do not double-count rider and mount regeneration.

Why the level-10 finale is separate

These unresolved actions, extremely high damage and multiple legendary-action pools make numerical CR labels insufficient for an honest balance claim. The recommended one-shot objective attacks the ritual, while these full sources remain intact for later campaign use.
